observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine on a white table, with a ruler along the edge. The machine has a metal needle area and a control panel with knobs and a dial. The surface is dusty and shows signs of use.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a front angle, with a white table and a power switch on the right. The machine has a yellow warning label and a red sticker. The needle area is visible with a circular logo and text. The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area.

Photo 2 shows a close-up of the machine's head, with the brand 'AMRO BROTHER' clearly visible on the side. The machine has a metal needle, thread guide, and a dial. The surface is dusty and shows wear. A ruler is placed along the edge of the table.
All photos show the machine in a used condition with visible dust, minor scratches, and signs of wear. The machine is not powered on in any photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used industrial sewing machine for sales.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear, dust, and minor scratches, contradicting 'neatly used'.
This is a subjective claim about suitability; no proof of performance or ease of use is visible.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, needle moving, and thread feeding smoothly.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or parts (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, manual).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

risks.risk: Machine may have electrical or mechanical faults not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of the machine operating under load or with a load test.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and operating smoothly.
Photo showing all included accessories (foot pedal, power cord, manual, etc.).
Photo of the machine's serial number or model number plate, if any.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
